customJs: function onMount(el,props){var root=el.querySelector('.wb-addon-pro-slider');if(!root)return;var track=root.querySelector('.wb-sl-track');var slides=root.querySelectorAll('.wb-sl-slide');if(!track||slides.length<2)return;var current=0;var total=slides.length;var autoPlay=root.getAttribute('data-autoplay')==='true'||props.autoPlay===true;var interval=parseInt(root.getAttribute('data-interval'))||4500;var timer=null;var dots=[];var dotsWrap=root.querySelector('.wb-sl-dots');if(dotsWrap){for(var i=0;i<total;i++){var d=document.createElement('span');d.className='wb-sl-dot'+(i===0?' active':'');d.setAttribute('data-idx',i);d.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-idx')));resetTimer();});dotsWrap.appendChild(d);dots.push(d);}}function goTo(idx){current=((idx%total)+total)%total;track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(current*100)+'%)';dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('active',i===current);});}var prev=root.querySelector('.wb-sl-arrow.prev');var next=root.querySelector('.wb-sl-arrow.next');if(prev)prev.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(current-1);resetTimer();});if(next)next.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(current+1);resetTimer();});function startTimer(){if(autoPlay)timer=setInterval(function(){goTo(current+1);},interval);}function resetTimer(){if(timer)clearInterval(timer);startTimer();}root.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){if(timer)clearInterval(timer);});root.addEventListener('mouseleave',startTimer);goTo(0);startTimer();}

customJs: function onMount(el,props){var root=el.querySelector('.wb-addon-pro-countdown');if(!root)return;var closeBtn=root.querySelector('.wb-cd-close');if(closeBtn){closeBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){root.style.display='none';});}var timers=root.querySelectorAll('.wb-cd-timer');function updateTimer(){timers.forEach(function(t){var target=new Date(t.getAttribute('data-target')).getTime();if(isNaN(target))return;var diff=Math.max(0,target-Date.now());var d=Math.floor(diff/86400000);var h=Math.floor((diff%86400000)/3600000);var m=Math.floor((diff%3600000)/60000);var s=Math.floor((diff%60000)/1000);var pad=function(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0');};var dEl=t.querySelector('.wb-cd-days');var hEl=t.querySelector('.wb-cd-hours');var mEl=t.querySelector('.wb-cd-mins');var sEl=t.querySelector('.wb-cd-secs');if(dEl)dEl.textContent=pad(d);if(hEl)hEl.textContent=pad(h);if(mEl)mEl.textContent=pad(m);if(sEl)sEl.textContent=pad(s);});}updateTimer();if(!window._wbCdProInterval){window._wbCdProInterval=setInterval(updateTimer,1000);}}

customJs: function onMount(el,props){var root=el.querySelector('.wb-addon-pro-counter');if(!root)return;function animateNum(numEl,target,decimals,duration){var start=performance.now();function tick(now){var t=Math.min((now-start)/duration,1);var ease=1-Math.pow(1-t,3);var cur=target*ease;numEl.textContent=cur.toFixed(decimals);if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else numEl.textContent=target.toFixed(decimals);}requestAnimationFrame(tick);}function runAll(){root.querySelectorAll('.wb-ct-num').forEach(function(numEl){var target=parseFloat(numEl.getAttribute('data-num'))||0;var dec=parseInt(numEl.getAttribute('data-dec'))||0;animateNum(numEl,target,dec,1800);});}if('IntersectionObserver' in window){var cards=root.querySelectorAll('.wb-ct-card');var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){var numEl=e.target.querySelector('.wb-ct-num');if(numEl){var target=parseFloat(numEl.getAttribute('data-num'))||0;var dec=parseInt(numEl.getAttribute('data-dec'))||0;animateNum(numEl,target,dec,1800);}obs.unobserve(e.target);}});},{threshold:0.3});cards.forEach(function(c){obs.observe(c);});}else{runAll();}}
